name: finish_episode
description: End the policy lifecycle using the observed outcome. Use when: check_task has returned true for success, or supported failure/abort meets the declared contract; do not finish while an action proposal is pending. Effect: persists the policy finish record and ends policy interaction without directly changing the world or evaluator. Returns: success and the accepted outcome. Does not: override the official Boolean verdict or convert a lifecycle declaration into physical success. On error: success needs the checker latch; failure needs a nonempty reason and nonempty exhausted attempts; correct the missing evidence rather than inventing it.

outcome.description: Policy lifecycle outcome: success requires a prior true checker result; failure requires reason and exhausted attempts; abort does not declare task success.

reason.description: Outcome rationale; omitted defaults to empty, but failure requires nonempty text.

attempts.description: Nonempty descriptions of exhausted attempts for failure; optional or null for other outcomes. Does not count as action evidence.
